meta.note: 25 net-new events for the 2026-11-15 round (window Nov 8–15)

events.title: McKinsey 发布《Global Banking Annual Review 2026》：AI 分裂红利
events.title_en: McKinsey releases Global Banking Annual Review 2026: the AI disruption dividend
events.summary: McKinsey 年度旗舰《全球银行业年度回顾》2026 版（11-10）：主题为「AI 分裂红利」——银行业 AI 采用分化带来的估值与格局重塑；路透同步报道其中「银行试图遏制 AI agent 成本飙升」的发现。
events.summary_en: McKinsey's flagship Global Banking Annual Review 2026 (Nov 10) centers on the AI disruption dividend; Reuters covered its finding on banks reining in soaring AI agent costs.

events.summary_en: On November 12, 2026, Deloitte announced (via D71 Ventures) the acquisition of Flipside Crypto's AI business (closed in July) and the launch of Edisyl Inc., positioned as 'the knowledge layer for enterprise AI'.

events.summary_en: PwC has trained 85,000 workers to use AI tools and is now teaching critical use and verification (Inc., November 10, 2026) — a scale talent signal plus responsible-AI narrative.
